title: PO-8935 Thermal Gel Formulation Revision Drift (Rev B.1 vs B.2)
question: ERP shows PO-8935 (1,800 cartridges of TIM-GEL-500G from NordicChem) is QUALITY_APPROVED under spec Rev B.1, but Line-A only has 20 hours of gel left because Chem-Vault-1 blocked 1,500 cartridges. Reconcile the spec mismatch across Zetaris sources and determine if we can safely use the quarantined Rev B.2 lot today.
expected_conflicts: ERP master specifies Rev B.1 and marks PO-8935 QUALITY_APPROVED vs Carrier manifest and WMS scan showing 1,500 cartridges arrived as Rev B.2.
Supplier claims Rev B.2 is a drop-in replacement vs QMS-431 lab rheology test showing 12% higher viscosity and 14% higher nozzle pressure requiring PLC dispense profile #4 before release.
